title: Memory leak from event listener not cleaned up on unmount
reasoning: The useEffect hook adds a click event listener to the replay button at line 310, but the cleanup function at lines 314-318 only clears timeouts/RAF and pauses audio. The event listener is never removed, causing a memory leak if the component unmounts and remounts multiple times.
reproduction: Navigate to /mro/demo, then navigate away and back multiple times. Each mount will add a new event listener without removing the previous one.
recommendation: Store the element reference and remove the event listener in the cleanup function. Example: const btn = el('mro-btn-replay'); const handler = () => {...}; btn?.addEventListener('click', handler); return () => { btn?.removeEventListener('click', handler); ... }
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are defined for this feature (tests array is empty in feature metadata). Memory leak detection requires integration testing with component mount/unmount cycles.
suggestedRegressionTest: Integration test: mount MRODemo, get initial listener count on replay button, unmount, remount, verify listener count hasn't increased. Or use React Testing Library to verify cleanup.
minimumFixScope: Lines 310-313 in src/src/pages/MRODemo.tsx - extract handler to variable, add removeEventListener in cleanup
